name: hex-app
description: Release metadata + changelog automation for the Hex macOS app.

scripts.release: rm -rf build dist && xcodebuild -scheme Hex -configuration Release -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build -skipMacroValidation CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO clean build && mkdir -p dist && cp -R build/Build/Products/Release/Hex.app dist/Hex.app && echo "Built release app at dist/Hex.app"
